password.title: Password
password.changed: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
password.googleOnly: You sign in with Google. Set a password to also sign in with email.
password.setDone: Password set. You can now sign in with email or Google.

data.title: Your data
data.exportBody: Download a JSON file with your profile, sign-in methods, sessions, bookings, reviews, comments and forum threads. It contains no passwords or session tokens.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: Your account, sessions and sign-in methods are deleted immediately. Bookings are kept for 24 months after departure to handle complaints, as stated in the Privacy Policy, but are no longer linked to an account.
delete.keep: Keep my reviews, comments and forum threads, anonymised
delete.remove: Delete my reviews, comments and forum threads too

errors.HAS_PASSWORD: This account already has a password.
errors.EMAIL_MISMATCH: That email doesn't match your account.
errors.FAILED: That didn't work, please try again.
